D011-D016_h001.question: "Lately, I just feel… wound up, you know? It's like my brain won't shut off. It jumps from one thing to the next, like a terrible game of dominoes. My body feels it too; my shoulders are always hunched, and my jaw is clenched so tight my teeth ache.
